meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('future, next').

examples.trans: That is the future mayor of Sineozersk!

examples.text: Это будущий мэр Синеозерска! Ну что, родной мой, за тебя!
examples.trans: That is the future mayor of Sineozersk! Well then, my dear friend, to you!

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('important').

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.

meanings.note: Проводить время = to spend time. Common neuter noun meaning 'time' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: usually the short form: я готов (m), я готова (f)
думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

meanings.note: + genitive plural: много дел. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

meanings.note: + infinitive. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'can, to be able', paired with 'смочь'.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: Talk over a matter. Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'судить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to discuss', paired with 'обсуждать'.

examples.text: Без лишних ушей обсудим твоё назначение.
examples.trans: Without extra ears we will discuss your appointment.
The partners discussed the terms of the deal in detail.

examples.text: Заодно без лишних ушей обсудим твоё назначение.
examples.trans: At the same time without extra ears we will discuss your appointment.

meanings.note: Used as an exclamation of approval. Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'лично'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Отлично, Ваня! Вот это твой образ!
examples.trans: Perfect, Vanya! That right there is your look!

meanings.note: Between people or groups. Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'ношение'). Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'attitude, relation; (pl.) relationship' in everyday Russian.

Towards someone or something. Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'ношение'). Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'attitude, relation; (pl.) relationship' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: А я испорчу отношения с будущим мэром.
examples.trans: And I'll ruin my relationship with the future mayor.
We have a very warm relationship.

examples.text: Ты с ума сошёл? У нас с тобой только деловые отношения!
examples.trans: Have you lost your mind? Between you and me it's strictly business!

meanings.note: In 'по поводу' + genitive. Core Russian prep meaning 'along; by; about' in everyday speech.

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)
meanings.note: Поговорить с + instrumental. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'говорить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to have a talk', paired with 'говорить'.

examples.text: Поговори с Аракеляном. Пусть он заберёт заявление.
examples.trans: Talk to Arakelyan. Get him to withdraw his statement.

meanings.note: Подожди! = wait!. Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to wait (a while)', paired with 'ждать'.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

meanings.note: Handing something over. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'жалуйста').
Answer to thanks. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'жалуйста').
Handing something over. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'жалуйста').

'Послушай!' / 'Послушайте!' = Listen! (to get attention)

Listen, look (to get attention). Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'слушать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to listen (for a while)', paired with 'слушать'.
On foot, once. Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to come, to arrive', paired with 'приходить'.

examples.trans: Security will be here any moment.

examples.text: Не надо, Самсон. Сейчас придёт охрана.
examples.trans: Don't, Samson. Security will be here any second.

meanings.note: Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'виваться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'develop'.

examples.text: Наши с тобой отношения развиваются слишком быстро.
examples.trans: Our relationship with each other is developing too fast.

examples.text: Молодой повар должен постоянно учиться и профессионально развиваться.

meanings.note: + accusative. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'лушать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to listen', paired with 'послушать'.
the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

'Слушаю' = I'm listening. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'лушать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to listen', paired with 'послушать'.

examples.text: Слушай, Самсон, я тут подумал. Твой начальник — такой опытный специалист.
